field.name: activ
field.description: PKC active: ACTIV=1 signals that a calculation is in progress or about to start

field.name: carry
field.description: Carry overflow flag: CARRY is set by the PKC at the end of a calculation in case; - an addition or multiplication with addition operation has been executed and an overflow in the most significant bit has occured

field.name: zero
field.description: Zero result flag: ZERO is set by the PKC at the end of a calculation in case the result of the calculation is equal zero

field.name: goany
field.description: Combined GO status flag: GOANY is set in case either PKC_CTRL

field.name: pw_ready
field.description: Asserted high by HW when the PKC_PROT_WORD is ready

field.name: locked
field.description: Parameter set locked: Indicates if parameter set is locked due to a pending calculation start or can be overwritten

field.name: reset
field.description: PKC reset control bit: RESET=1 enforces the PKC's reset state during which a calculation cannot be started and by which any ongoing calculation process is stopped

field.name: stop
field.description: Freeze PKC calculation: STOP=1 freezes all PKC activity incl

field.name: god1
field.description: Control bit to start direct operation using parameter set 1: If GOD1 is set PKC will start a direct / layer0 operation using parameter set 1 (PKC_MODE1, PKC_XYPTR1, PKC_ZRPTR1, PKC_LEN1)

field.name: god2
field.description: Control bit to start direct operation using parameter set 2: If GOD2 is set PKC will start a direct / layer0 operation using parameter set 2 (PKC_MODE2, PKC_XYPTR2, PKC_ZRPTR2, PKC_LEN2)

field.name: gom1
field.description: Control bit to start MC pattern using parameter set 1: If GOM1 is set PKC will start a MC pattern / layer1 operation using parameter set 1 (PKC_MODE1, PKC_XYPTR1, PKC_ZRPTR1, PKC_LEN1)

field.name: gom2
field.description: Control bit to start MC pattern using parameter set 2: If GOM2 is set PKC will start a MC pattern / layer1 operation using parameter set 2 (PKC_MODE2, PKC_XYPTR2, PKC_ZRPTR2, PKC_LEN2)

field.name: gou
field.description: Control bit to start pipe operation: If GOU is set PKC will start the pipe / layer2 operation (parameter fetch & calculation) described in section 'PKC Universal Pointer Fetch Operation'

field.name: gf2conv
field.description: Convert to GF2 calculation modes: If GF2CONV is set operations are mapped to their GF(2) equivalent operation modes

field.name: clrcache
field.description: Clear universal pointer cache: Invalidates the cache such that all previously fetched parameters are withdrawn and have to be fetched again via DMA accesses

field.name: cache_en
field.description: Enable universal pointer cache: If CACHE_EN=1 the cache for the universal pointer parameters is enabled

field.name: redmul
field.description: Reduced multiplier mode: REDMUL defines the operand width processed by the PKC coprocessor

field.name: pw_update
field.description: Asserted by SW to initiate a reload of the PKC_PROT_WORD, causes PW_READY to be cleared until ready again

field.name: idleop
field.description: Idle operation configuration: If IDLEOP is set idle / dummy operations are executed as soon as PKC_CTRL

field.name: clkrnd
field.description: Clock randomization configuration: CLKRND=1 activates the PKC clock randomization

field.name: redmulnoise
field.description: Noise in reduced multiplier mode feature not available in this version (flag is don't care).

field.name: rnddly
field.description: Random delay configuration: Define random delay cycles introduced randomly before and after real calculation

field.name: sbxnoise
field.description: Noise in the SBOXES: When the SBOXES are not used circuitry is loaded with random data to increase the noise level

field.name: alpnoise
field.description: Noise in Arith & Logic Path: When not used circuitry is loaded with random data to increase the noise level

field.name: fmulnoise
field.description: Noise in Full Multiplier Path: When not used circuitry is loaded with random data to increase the noise level

field.name: mode
field.description: Calculation Mode / MC Start address:; Calculation mode of direct calculation (layer0) are listed in a table in Section 'PKC arithmetic unit (layer 0)'

field.name: xptr
field.description: Start address of X operand in PKCRAM with byte granularity: Least significant bits are ignored depending on PKC_CTRL

field.name: yptr
field.description: Start address of Y operand in PKCRAM with byte granularity: Least significant bits are ignored depending on PKC_CTRL

field.name: zptr
field.description: Start address of Z operand in PKCRAM with byte granularity or constant for calculation modes using CONST:; If ZPTR is used as address pointer the least significant bits are ignored depending on PKC_CTRL

field.name: rptr
field.description: Start address of R result in PKCRAM with byte granularity: Least significant bits are ignored depending on PKC_CTRL

field.name: len
field.description: Operand length: LEN defines the length of the operands and the result in bytes

field.name: mclen
field.description: Loop counter for microcode pattern: MCLEN defines the length of the loop counter that can be used in layer1 calculation mode, e

field.name: ptr

field.name: ptr
field.description: Pointer to start address of PKC FUP table: PKC_UPTRT needs to be defined before starting a universal pointer PKC calculation (layer2) via PKC_CTRL

field.name: len
field.description: Length of universal pointer calculation: PKC_ULEN defines how many FUP program entries shall be processed for one layer2 calculation started via PKC_CTRL

field.name: mcdata

field.name: mulsize

field.name: paramnum

field.name: mcreconf_size

field.name: soft_rst

field.name: ahb

field.name: fdet

field.name: en_pdone

field.name: en_pdone
field.description: Write to set PDONE interrupt enable flag (PKC_INT_ENABLE.EN_PDONE=1).

field.name: int_pdone
field.description: End-of-computation status flag: INT_PDONE is set after EACH single PKC layer0 or layer1 calculation

field.name: en_pdone
field.description: PDONE interrupt enable flag: If EN_PDONE=1 an interrupt is triggered every time PKC_INT_STATUS

field.name: int_pdone
field.description: Write to clear End-of-computation status flag (PKC_INT_STATUS.INT_PDONE=0).

field.name: int_pdone
field.description: Write to set End-of-computation status flag (PKC_INT_STATUS

field.name: val
field.description: 32-bit mask used for SW assisted SFR-IF masking; The PKC applies the mask on all APB read data that is provided during SFR reads (except for reading PKC_SFR_MASK for which the value is provided in plain)

enumeratedValue.name: NOBUF
enumeratedValue.description: Instruction fetches from flash are not buffered.

enumeratedValue.name: ONEBUF
enumeratedValue.description: One buffer is used for all instruction fetches.

enumeratedValue.name: ALLBUF
enumeratedValue.description: All buffers may be used for instruction fetches.

enumeratedValue.name: NOBUF
enumeratedValue.description: Data accesses from flash are not buffered.

enumeratedValue.name: ONEBUF
enumeratedValue.description: One buffer is used for all data accesses.

enumeratedValue.name: ALLBUF
enumeratedValue.description: All buffers can be used for data accesses.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Any previously initiated prefetch will be completed.

enumeratedValue.name: OVERRIDE
enumeratedValue.description: Any previously initiated prefetch will be aborted, and the next flash line following the current execution address will be prefetched if not already buffered.

field.description: output to observe the functional post-divider test.

field.name: BYPASSPLL
field.description: Bypass PLL input clock is sent directly to the PLL output (default).

enumeratedValue.name: BYPASSED
enumeratedValue.description: Bypass PLL input clock is sent directly to the PLL output.

field.name: BYPASSPOSTDIV2
field.description: bypass of the divide-by-2 divider in the post-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: USED
enumeratedValue.description: use the divide-by-2 divider in the post-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: BYPASSED
enumeratedValue.description: bypass of the divide-by-2 divider in the post-divider.

field.name: LIMUPOFF
field.description: limup_off = 1 in spread spectrum and fractional PLL applications.

field.name: BWDIRECT
field.description: Control of the bandwidth of the PLL.

enumeratedValue.name: SYNC
enumeratedValue.description: the bandwidth is changed synchronously with the feedback-divider.

enumeratedValue.name: DIRECT
enumeratedValue.description: modify the bandwidth of the PLL directly.

field.name: FRMCLKSTABLE
field.description: free running mode clockstable: Warning: Only make frm_clockstable =1 after the PLL output frequency is stable.

field.name: LOCK
field.description: lock detector output (active high) Warning: The lock signal is only reliable between fref[2] :100 kHz to 20 MHz.

field.name: MD_LBS
field.description: input word of the wrapper bit 31 to 0.

field.name: MD_MBS
field.description: input word of the wrapper bit 32.

field.name: MF
field.description: programmable modulation frequency fm = Fref/Nss mf[2:0] = 000 => Nss=512 (fm ~ 3.

field.name: MR
field.description: programmable frequency modulation depth Dfmodpk-pk = Fref*kss/Fcco = kss/(2*md[32:25]dec) mr[2:0] = 000 => kss = 0 (no spread spectrum) mr[2:0] = 001 => kss ~ 1 mr[2:0] = 010 => kss ~ 1.

field.name: MC
field.description: modulation waveform control Compensation for low pass filtering of the PLL to get a triangular modulation at the output of the PLL, giving a flat frequency spectrum.

field.name: MDIV_EXT
field.description: to select an external mdiv value.

field.name: MREQ
field.description: to select an external mreq value.

field.name: DITHER
field.description: dithering between two modulation frequencies in a random way or in a pseudo random way (white noise), in order to decrease the probability that the modulated waveform will occur with the same phase on a particular point on the screen.

field.name: SEL_EXT
field.description: to select mdiv_ext and mreq_ext sel_ext = 0: mdiv ~ md[32:0], mreq = 1 sel_ext = 1 : mdiv = mdiv_ext, mreq = mreq_ext.

field.name: NFUNCTEST

field.name: MFUNCTEST
field.description: input to functional test the feedback-divider (M-divider).

field.name: PFUNCTEST
field.description: input to functional test the post-divider (P-divider).

field.name: NMOTEST
field.description: output to observe the functional pre-divider test.

field.name: MMOTEST
field.description: output to observe the functional feedback-divider test.

field.name: PMOTEST
field.description: output to observe the functional post-divider test.

field.description: When DAP to AP0 for CPU0 (CM33) debug access is allowed, this bit indicates state 1.

field.name: ST_DAP_ENABLE_DSP
field.description: When DAP to AP3 for DSP (Coolflux) debug access is allowed, this bit indicates state 1.

field.name: ST_CSS_DEBUG_EN
field.description: When CSS uCode code fetch out of AHB for debug is enabled, this bit indicates state 1.

field.name: ST_ALLOW_TEST_ACCESS
field.description: When JTAG TAP access is allowed, this bit indicates state 1.

field.name: ST_XO32K_FAILED
field.description: When XO32K oscillation fail flag is state 1 in PMC register block, this bit indicates state 1.

field.name: ST_QK_PUF_SCORE
field.description: These register bits indicate the state of "qk_puf_score[3:0]" outputs from QK PUF block.

field.name: ST_QK_ZEROIZED
field.description: This register bit indicates the state of "qk_zeroized" output from QK PUF block.

field.name: ST_MAIN_CLK_IS_EXT
field.description: When MAIN_CLK is running from external clock source either XO32M, XO32K or GPIO CLKIN, this bit indicates state 1.

field.name: ST_DCDC_VOUT
field.description: VOUT[3:0] setting on DCDC0 register in PMC block will reflect to this register.

field.name: ST_BOOT_MODE
field.description: BOOTMODE[1:0] status on STATUS register in PMC block will reflect to this register.

field.name: FLAG_AP_ENABLE_CPU0
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when DAP enables AP0 for CPU0 (CM33) debug access. The register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_AP_ENABLE_DSP
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when DAP enbales AP3 for DSP (Coolflux) debug access. The register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_BOD_VBAT_RESET_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when BOD VBAT reset is enabled and BOD VBAT analog detector is tripped. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

field.name: FLAG_BOD_CORE_RESET_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when BOD CORE reset is enabled and BOD CORE analog detector is tripped. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

field.name: FLAG_BOD_VBAT_IRQ_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when BOD VBAT IRQ is enabled and BOD VBAT analog detector is tripped. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_BOD_CORE_IRQ_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when BOD CORE IRQ is enabled and BOD CORE analog detector is tripped. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_WDT_RESET_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when WatchDog Timer reset is enabled and reset event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

field.name: FLAG_CWDT_RESET_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when Code WatchDog Timer reset is enabled and reset event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

field.name: FLAG_WDT_IRQ_OCCURED
field.description: This flag register is set 1 when WatchDog Timer IRQ is enabled and IRQ event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_CWDT_IRQ_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when Code WatchDog Timer IRQ is enabled and IRQ event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_QK_ERROR
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when QK_ERROR is flagged from QK PUF block. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_CSS_GLITCH_DETECTED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when GDET error is flagged from CSS. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_ANA_GLITCH_DETECTED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when ANALOG GDET error is flagged in SYSCON block. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_TAMPER_EVENT_DETECTED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when tamper event is flagged from RTC. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR or by PMC reset event, if ranmpr detection event is cleared by software.

field.name: FLAG_FLASH_ECC_INVALID
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when FLASH controller indicates ECC error. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_SEC_VIOL_IRQ_OCURRED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when security violation is indicated from FLASH sub-system or AHB bus matrix.

field.name: FLAG_CPU0_NS_C_ACC_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set 1 when CPU0 (CM33) makes non-secure code transactions. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_CPU0_NS_D_ACC_OCCURED
field.description: This flag register is set 1 when CPU0 (CM33) makes non-secure data transactions. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

enumeratedValue.description: Pin is enabled and contributes to the grouped interrupt

register.name: IENR
register.description: Pin Interrupt Level or Rising Edge Interrupt Enable

enumeratedValue.name: ENRL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable rising edge or level interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: ENRL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable rising edge or level interrupt

register.name: SIENR
register.description: Pin Interrupt Level or Rising Edge Interrupt Set

enumeratedValue.name: SETENRL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable rising edge or level interrupt

register.name: CIENR
register.description: Pin Interrupt Level (Rising Edge Interrupt) Clear

enumeratedValue.name: CENRL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Disable rising edge or level interrupt

register.name: IENF
register.description: Pin Interrupt Active Level or Falling Edge Interrupt Enable

enumeratedValue.name: ENAF_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable falling edge interrupt or set active interrupt level LOW

enumeratedValue.name: ENAF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable falling edge interrupt enabled or set active interrupt level HIGH

register.name: SIENF
register.description: Pin Interrupt Active Level or Falling Edge Interrupt Set

enumeratedValue.name: SETENAF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Select HIGH-active interrupt or enable falling edge interrupt

register.name: CIENF
register.description: Pin Interrupt Active Level or Falling Edge Interrupt Clear

enumeratedValue.name: CENAF_1
enumeratedValue.description: LOW-active interrupt selected or falling edge interrupt disabled

enumeratedValue.name: RDET_0
enumeratedValue.description: Read 0- No rising edge has been detected on this pin since Reset or the last time a one was written to this bit, Write 0- no operation

enumeratedValue.name: RDET_1
enumeratedValue.description: Read 1- a rising edge has been detected since Reset or the last time a one was written to this bit, Write 1- clear rising edge detection for this pin

enumeratedValue.name: FDET_0
enumeratedValue.description: Read 0- No falling edge has been detected on this pin since Reset or the last time a one was written to this bit, Write 0- no operation

enumeratedValue.name: FDET_1
enumeratedValue.description: Read 1- a falling edge has been detected since Reset or the last time a one was written to this bit, Write 1- clear falling edge detection for this bit

enumeratedValue.name: PSTAT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Read 0- interrupt is not being requested for this pin, Write 0- no operation.

enumeratedValue.name: PSTAT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Read 1- interrupt is being requested for this pin, Write 1 (edge-sensitive)- clear rising- and falling-edge detection for this pin, Write 1 (level-sensitive)- switch the active level for this pin (in the IENF register).

field.name: SEL_PMATCH
field.description: Specifies whether the pin interrupts are controlled by the pin interrupt function or by the pattern match function.

enumeratedValue.name: PIN_INTERRUPT
enumeratedValue.description: Pin interrupt- interrupts are driven in response to the standard pin interrupt function.

enumeratedValue.name: PATTERN_MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Pattern match- interrupts are driven in response to pattern matches.

field.name: ENA_RXEV

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled- RXEV output to the CPU is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled- RXEV output to the CPU is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: PMAT_1

field.name: PROD_ENDPTS0

enumeratedValue.description: No effect. Slice 0 is not an endpoint.

enumeratedValue.name: ENDPOINT
enumeratedValue.description: Endpoint. Slice 0 is the endpoint of a product term (minterm). Pin interrupt 0 in the NVIC is raised if the minterm evaluates as true.

field.name: CFG0
field.description: Specifies the match contribution condition for bit slice 0.

enumeratedValue.name: STICKY_RISING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Sticky rising edge. Match occurs if a rising edge on the specified input has occurred since the last time the edge detection for this bit slice was cleared. This match condition is only cleared when the PMCFG or the PMSRC registers are written to.

enumeratedValue.name: STICKY_FALLING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Sticky falling edge. Match occurs if a falling edge on the specified input has occurred since the last time the edge detection for this bit slice was cleared. This match condition is only cleared when the PMCFG or the PMSRC registers are written to.

enumeratedValue.name: STICKY_RISING_FALLING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Sticky rising or falling edge. Match occurs if either a rising or falling edge on the specified input has occurred since the last time the edge detection for this bit slice was cleared. This match condition is only cleared when the PMCFG or the PMSRC registers are written to.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH_LEVEL
enumeratedValue.description: High level. Match (for this bit slice) occurs when there is a high level on the input specified for this bit slice in the PMSRC register.

enumeratedValue.name: LOW_LEVEL
enumeratedValue.description: Low level. Match occurs when there is a low level on the specified input.

enumeratedValue.name: CONSTANT_ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Constant 0. This bit slice never contributes to a match (should be used to disable any unused bit slices).

enumeratedValue.name: EVENT
enumeratedValue.description: Event. Non-sticky rising or falling edge. Match occurs on an event when either a rising or falling edge is first detected on the specified input (this is a non-sticky version of value 0x3). This bit is cleared after 1 clock cycle.

enumeratedValue.name: LOW_LEVEL
enumeratedValue.description: Low level. Match occurs when there is a low level on the specified input.

enumeratedValue.name: CONSTANT_ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Constant 0. This bit slice never contributes to a match (should be used to disable any unused bit slices).

enumeratedValue.name: EVENT
enumeratedValue.description: Event. Non-sticky rising or falling edge. Match occurs on an event when either a rising or falling edge is first detected on the specified input (this is a non-sticky version of value 0x3). This bit is cleared after 1 clock cycle.

field.name: CFG7
field.description: Specifies the match contribution condition for bit slice 7.

enumeratedValue.name: STICKY_RISING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Sticky rising edge. Match occurs if a rising edge on the specified input has occurred since the last time the edge detection for this bit slice was cleared. This match condition is only cleared when the PMCFG or the PMSRC registers are written to.

enumeratedValue.name: STICKY_FALLING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Sticky falling edge. Match occurs if a falling edge on the specified input has occurred since the last time the edge detection for this bit slice was cleared. This match condition is only cleared when the PMCFG or the PMSRC registers are written to.

enumeratedValue.name: STICKY_RISING_FALLING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Sticky rising or falling edge. Match occurs if either a rising or falling edge on the specified input has occurred since the last time the edge detection for this bit slice was cleared. This match condition is only cleared when the PMCFG or the PMSRC registers are written to.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH_LEVEL
enumeratedValue.description: High level. Match (for this bit slice) occurs when there is a high level on the input specified for this bit slice in the PMSRC register.

enumeratedValue.name: LOW_LEVEL
enumeratedValue.description: Low level. Match occurs when there is a low level on the specified input.

enumeratedValue.name: CONSTANT_ZERO
enumeratedValue.description: Constant 0. This bit slice never contributes to a match (should be used to disable any unused bit slices).

enumeratedValue.name: EVENT
enumeratedValue.description: Event. Non-sticky rising or falling edge. Match occurs on an event when either a rising or falling edge is first detected on the specified input (this is a non-sticky version of value 0x3). This bit is cleared after 1 clock cycle.

field.name: CR0INT
field.description: Interrupt flag for capture channel 0 event

field.name: CR1INT
field.description: Interrupt flag for capture channel 1 event

field.name: CR2INT
field.description: Interrupt flag for capture channel 2 event

field.name: CR3INT
field.description: Interrupt flag for capture channel 3 event

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The Timer Counter and Prescale Counter are enabled. When the timer is enabled by an external trigger or globally enabled by the external global start enable register, the CEN bit will automatically be set to 1.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Allow input global_enable=1 action to take effect

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Allow input trigger_enable=1 action to take effect

field.name: CAP0RE
field.description: Rising edge of capture channel 0: a sequence of 0 then 1 causes CR0 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP0FE
field.description: Falling edge of capture channel 0: a sequence of 1 then 0 causes CR0 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP0I
field.description: Generate interrupt on channel 0 capture event: a CR0 load generates an interrupt.

field.name: CAP1RE
field.description: Rising edge of capture channel 1: a sequence of 0 then 1 causes CR1 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP1FE
field.description: Falling edge of capture channel 1: a sequence of 1 then 0 causes CR1 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP1I
field.description: Generate interrupt on channel 1 capture event: a CR1 load generates an interrupt.

field.name: CAP2RE
field.description: Rising edge of capture channel 2: a sequence of 0 then 1 causes CR2 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP2FE
field.description: Falling edge of capture channel 2: a sequence of 1 then 0 causes CR2 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP2I
field.description: Generate interrupt on channel 2 capture event: a CR2 load generates an interrupt.

field.name: CAP3RE
field.description: Rising edge of capture channel 3: a sequence of 0 then 1 causes CR3 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP3FE
field.description: Falling edge of capture channel 3: a sequence of 1 then 0 causes CR3 to be loaded with the contents of TC.

field.name: CAP3I
field.description: Generate interrupt on channel 3 capture event: a CR3 load generates an interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: CLEAR

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set. Set the corresponding External Match bit/output to 1 (MAT0 pin is HIGH if pinned out).

enumeratedValue.name: TOGGLE
enumeratedValue.description: Toggle. Toggle the corresponding External Match bit/output.

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set. Set the corresponding External Match bit/output to 1 (MAT1 pin is HIGH if pinned out).

enumeratedValue.name: SET

enumeratedValue.name: TOGGLE

field.name: CTMODE
field.description: The Count Control Register (CTCR) is used to select between Timer and Counter mode, and in Counter mode to select the pin and edge(s) for counting.

field.name: ENCC
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 enables clearing of the timer and the prescaler when the capture-edge event specified in bits 7:5 occurs

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_0_RISING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 0 Rising Edge. Rising edge of the signal on capture channel 0 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_0_FALLING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 0 Falling Edge. Falling edge of the signal on capture channel 0 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_1_RISING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 1 Rising Edge. Rising edge of the signal on capture channel 1 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_1_FALLING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 1 Falling Edge. Falling edge of the signal on capture channel 1 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_2_RISING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 2 Rising Edge. Rising edge of the signal on capture channel 2 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: CHANNEL_2_FALLING
enumeratedValue.description: Channel 2 Falling Edge. Falling edge of the signal on capture channel 2 clears the timer (if bit 4 is set).

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Match. CTIMERn_MAT0 is controlled by EM0.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM
enumeratedValue.description: PWM. PWM mode is enabled for CTIMERn_MAT0.

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Match. CTIMERn_MAT01 is controlled by EM1.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM
enumeratedValue.description: PWM. PWM mode is enabled for CTIMERn_MAT1.

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Match. CTIMERn_MAT2 is controlled by EM2.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM
enumeratedValue.description: PWM. PWM mode is enabled for CTIMERn_MAT2.

field.name: PWMEN3
field.description: PWM mode enable for channel3. Note: It is recommended to use match channel 3 to set the PWM cycle.

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: Match. CTIMERn_MAT3 is controlled by EM3.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM
enumeratedValue.description: PWM. PWM mode is enabled for CT132Bn_MAT3.

enumeratedValue.name: STOP
enumeratedValue.description: Stop. The Watchdog timer is stopped.

enumeratedValue.name: RUN
enumeratedValue.description: Run. The Watchdog timer is running.

enumeratedValue.name: INTERRUPT
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt. A Watchdog timeout will not cause a chip reset.

enumeratedValue.name: RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Reset. A Watchdog timeout will cause a chip reset.

enumeratedValue.name: RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Reset. Causes a chip reset if WDRESET = 1.

enumeratedValue.name: FLAG
enumeratedValue.description: Flag. The Watchdog interrupt flag is set when the Watchdog counter is no longer greater than the value specified by WARNINT.

field.name: LOAD
field.description: Determines how the timer interval value (IVALUE -1) is loaded into the TIMER n register.

field.name: VALUE
field.description: Holds the current timer value of the down-counter.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. TIMER n interrupt is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. TIMER n interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_PENDING_INTERRUPT
enumeratedValue.description: No pending interrupt. Writing a zero is equivalent to no operation.

field.name: RUN
field.description: Indicates the state of TIMER n. RUN bit is read-only.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE_STATE
enumeratedValue.description: Idle state. TIMER n has stopped.

enumeratedValue.name: NO
enumeratedValue.description: This timer channel is not in use.

enumeratedValue.name: YES
enumeratedValue.description: This timer channel is in use. Writing a 1 to this bit clears the status.

field.name: NOC
field.description: Number Of Channels: identifies the number of channels in this MRT. (Minus 1 encoded)

field.name: NOB
field.description: Number Of Bits: identifies the number of timer bits in this MRT. (24 bits on this device)

field.name: MULTITASK
field.description: Selects the operating mode for the INUSE flags and the IDLE_CH register.

enumeratedValue.name: HARDWARE_STATUS_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware status mode. In this mode, the INUSE(n) flags for all channels are reset.

field.name: GFLAG0
field.description: Monitors the interrupt flag of TIMER0.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_PENDING_INTERRUPT
enumeratedValue.description: No pending interrupt. Writing a zero is equivalent to no operation.

field.name: GFLAG1
field.description: Monitors the interrupt flag of TIMER1, and acts similarly to channel 0.

field.name: GFLAG2
field.description: Monitors the interrupt flag of TIMER2, and acts similarly to channel 0.

field.name: GFLAG3
field.description: Monitors the interrupt flag of TIMER3, and acts similarly to channel 0.

enumeratedValue.name: TIMERISNOTACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: The Micro-Tick Timer is not active (stopped)

enumeratedValue.name: TIMERISACTIVE
enumeratedValue.description: The Micro-Tick Timer is currently active

enumeratedValue.name: CAPCLR0CLEARED
enumeratedValue.description: Write 1 to clear the CAP0 register value

enumeratedValue.name: CAPCLR1CLEARED
enumeratedValue.description: Write 1 to clear the CAP1 register value

enumeratedValue.name: CAPCLR2CLEARED
enumeratedValue.description: Write 1 to clear the CAP2 register value

enumeratedValue.name: CAPCLR3CLEARED
enumeratedValue.description: Write 1 to clear the CAP3 register value

field.name: CAP_VALUE
field.description: Captured value for the related capture event

enumeratedValue.name: NOTVALID
enumeratedValue.description: A valid value has been not been captured

enumeratedValue.name: VALID
enumeratedValue.description: A valid value has been captured, based on a transition of the related UTICK_CAPn pin

enumeratedValue.name: CYCLE_DONE

enumeratedValue.name: IN_PROGRESS
enumeratedValue.description: In Progress. Measurement cycle is in progress.

enumeratedValue.name: FREQ_ME_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Frequency Measurement Mode. FREQMECTRL works in a Frequency Measurement mode. Once the measurement starts (real count start is aligned at rising edge arrival on reference clock), the target counter increments by the target clock until the reference counter running by the reference clock reaches the count end point selected by REF_SCALE.

enumeratedValue.name: PULSE_ME_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Pulse Width Measurement mode. FREQMECTRL works in a Pulse Width Measurement mode, measuring the high or low period of reference clock input selected by PULSE_POL. The target counter starts incrementing by the target clock once a corresponding trigger edge (rising edge for high period measurement and falling edge for low period) occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH_PERIOD
enumeratedValue.description: High Period. High period of reference clock is measured in Pulse Width Measurement mode triggered by the rising edge on the reference clock input.

enumeratedValue.name: LOW_PERIOD
enumeratedValue.description: Low Period. Low period of reference clock is measured in Pulse Width Measurement mode triggered by the falling edge on the reference clock input.

field.name: P1_BYTE_SEL

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Sets the filter to 4-byte address mode

field.name: P1_BYTE_SEL_MD
field.description: Address Byte Select Mode for P1

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Operation. The Address byte mode is determined by the Op Code Command

field.name: P1_FLT_EN
field.description: Filter Enable bit for P1 filter

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Filter Enabled. CS# inputs to the filter are enabled and the filter state machine controls the CS disable outputs. This bit takes priority over the P1_BYP_EN bit in the Test Control Register. Setting this bit will enable filtering and will enable communication to flash devices regardless of the state of P1_BYP_EN. All other register controls remain functional while filtering is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Single Flash Mode. Supports a single physical flash device as described in Section 3.2. Note that all Chip Erase Op Codes are blocked when in this mode.

field.name: P0_ACT_SEL
field.description: Active Chip Select for P0 filter

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Sets CS1 as the read location for the firmware image and sets CS0 as the write location for the FW image.

field.name: P0_BYTE_SEL
field.description: Address Byte Select for P0 filter

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Sets the filter to 4-byte address mode

field.name: P0_BYTE_SEL_MD
field.description: Address Byte Select Mode for P0 filter

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Sets the Byte Mode to 3-byte and gives control of the function to the P0_BYTE_SEL in the P0 Filter Control Register. In this mode, any changes to P0_BYTE_SEL are latched and the internal state of BYTE_SEL will retain this value when P0_BYTE_SEL_MD is cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Filter Enabled. CS# inputs to the filter are enabled and the filter state machine controls the CS disable outputs. CS# inputs to the filter are enabled so that the filter state machine is active. All other register controls are functional.

enumeratedValue.name: DFM
enumeratedValue.description: Dual Flash Mode. Supports two separate physical flash devices as described in Section 3.1

enumeratedValue.name: SFM
enumeratedValue.description: Single Flash Mode. Supports a single physical flash device as described in Section 3.2. Note that all Chip Erase Op Codes are blocked when in this mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware triggering not used for channel.

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE_LOW_FALLING
enumeratedValue.description: Active low - falling edge. Hardware trigger is active low or falling edge triggered, based on TRIGTYPE.

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE_HIGH_RISING
enumeratedValue.description: Active high - rising edge. Hardware trigger is active high or rising edge triggered, based on TRIGTYPE.

enumeratedValue.name: EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Edge. Hardware trigger is edge triggered. Transfers will be initiated and completed, as specified for a single trigger.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. Destination burst wrapping is not enabled for this DMA channel.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. Destination burst wrapping is enabled for this DMA channel.

field.name: CHPRIORITY
field.description: Priority of channel when multiple DMA requests are pending.

register.name: CTLSTAT
register.description: Control and status register for DMA channel

field.name: VALIDPENDING
field.description: Valid pending flag for this channel.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_TRIGGERED
enumeratedValue.description: Not triggered. The trigger for this DMA channel is not set. DMA operations will not be carried out.

enumeratedValue.name: TRIGGERED
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered. The trigger for this DMA channel is set. DMA operations will be carried out.

register.name: XFERCFG
register.description: Transfer configuration register for DMA channel

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The channels' control structure should not be reloaded when the current descriptor is exhausted.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The channels' control structure should be reloaded when the current descriptor is exhausted.

field.name: SETINTA
field.description: Set Interrupt flag A for channel.

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set. The INTA flag for this channel will be set when the current descriptor is exhausted.

field.name: SETINTB
field.description: Set Interrupt flag B for channel.

enumeratedValue.name: SET
enumeratedValue.description: Set. The INTB flag for this channel will be set when the current descriptor is exhausted.

field.name: WIDTH
field.description: Transfer width used for this DMA channel.

field.name: XFERCOUNT
field.description: Total number of transfers to be performed, minus 1 encoded.

field.name: FORCE_NEEDCLK
field.description: Forces the NEEDCLK output to always be on:

enumeratedValue.name: ALWAYS_ON
enumeratedValue.description: USB_NEEDCLK always 1. Clock will not be stopped in case of suspend.

field.name: INTONNAK_AO
field.description: Interrupt on NAK for interrupt and bulk OUT EP

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Only acknowledged packets generate an interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Both acknowledged and NAKed packets generate interrupts.

field.name: INTONNAK_AI
field.description: Interrupt on NAK for interrupt and bulk IN EP

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Only acknowledged packets generate an interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Both acknowledged and NAKed packets generate interrupts.

field.name: INTONNAK_CO

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Only acknowledged packets generate an interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Both acknowledged and NAKed packets generate interrupts.

field.name: INTONNAK_CI

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Only acknowledged packets generate an interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED

field.name: LPM_REWP
field.description: LPM Remote Wake-up Enabled by USB host

field.name: VBUSDEBOUNCED
field.description: This bit indicates if Vbus is detected or not

field.name: ERR_CODE
field.description: The error code which last occurred:

register.name: EPLISTSTART
register.description: USB EP Command/Status List start address

field.name: EP_LIST
field.description: Start address of the USB EP Command/Status List.

field.name: DA_BUF
field.description: Start address of the buffer pointer page where all endpoint data buffers are located.

enumeratedValue.name: DUAL_COUNTER
enumeratedValue.description: Dual counter. The SCT operates as two 16-bit counters named COUNTER_L and COUNTER_H.

enumeratedValue.name: UNIFIED_COUNTER
enumeratedValue.description: Unified counter. The SCT operates as a unified 32-bit counter.

enumeratedValue.name: SYSTEM_CLOCK_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the entire SCT module including all counters and counter prescalers.

enumeratedValue.name: SAMPLED_SYSTEM_CLOCK_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Sampled System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the SCT module, but the counter and prescalers are only enabled to count when the designated edge is detected on the input selected by the CKSEL field. The minimum pulse width on the selected clock-gate input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the high-performance, sampled-clock mode.

enumeratedValue.name: SCT_INPUT_CLOCK_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: SCT Input Clock Mode. The input/edge selected by the CKSEL field clocks the SCT module, including all counters and prescalers, after first being synchronized to the system clock. The minimum pulse width on the clock input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the low-power, sampled-clock mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ASYNCHRONOUS_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Asynchronous Mode. The entire SCT module is clocked directly by the input/edge selected by the CKSEL field. In this mode, the SCT outputs are switched synchronously to the SCT input clock - not the system clock. The input clock rate must be at least half the system clock rate and can be the same or faster than the system clock.

field.name: CKSEL
field.description: SCT Clock Select. The specific functionality of the designated input/edge is dependent on the CLKMODE bit selection in this register.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_RELOAD
enumeratedValue.description: No Reload. Prevents the lower match registers from being reloaded from their respective reload registers.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_RELOAD_H
enumeratedValue.description: No Reload. Prevents the higher match registers from being reloaded from their respective reload registers.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable. A match on match register 0 is the LIMIT condition. No need to define an associated event.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enable. A match on match register 0 is the LIMIT condition. No need to define an associated event.

enumeratedValue.name: UP
enumeratedValue.description: Up. The L or unified counter is counting up.

enumeratedValue.name: DOWN
enumeratedValue.description: Down. The L or unified counter is counting down.

enumeratedValue.name: UP

field.name: STARTMSK_L

field.name: STARTMSK_H
field.description: If bit n is one, event n clears the CTRL[STOP_H] = 0 (event 0 = bit 16, event 1 = bit 17, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.

field.name: DITHER_L
field.description: If bit n is one, event n clears the CTRL[STOP_L] = 0 (event 0 = bit 0, event 1 = bit 1, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.

field.name: DITHER_H
field.description: If bit n is one, event n clears the CTRL[STOP_H] = 0 (event 0 = bit 16, event 1 = bit 17, etc.). The number of bits = number of events in this SCT.

enumeratedValue.description: Selects the inputs selected by IOSEL.

enumeratedValue.description: Selects the outputs selected by IOSEL.

enumeratedValue.name: OR
enumeratedValue.description: OR. The event occurs when either the specified match or I/O condition occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: MATCH
enumeratedValue.description: MATCH. Uses the specified match only.

enumeratedValue.name: IO
enumeratedValue.description: IO. Uses the specified I/O condition only.

enumeratedValue.name: AND
enumeratedValue.description: AND. The event occurs when the specified match and I/O condition occur simultaneously.

enumeratedValue.name: ADD
enumeratedValue.description: Add. STATEV value is added into STATE (the carry-out is ignored).

enumeratedValue.name: LOAD
enumeratedValue.description: Load. STATEV value is loaded into STATE.

enumeratedValue.name: DIRECTION_INDEPENDENT
enumeratedValue.description: Direction independent. This event is triggered regardless of the count direction.

enumeratedValue.name: COUNTING_UP
enumeratedValue.description: Counting up. This event is triggered only during up-counting when BIDIR = 1.

enumeratedValue.name: COUNTING_DOWN
enumeratedValue.description: Counting down. This event is triggered only during down-counting when BIDIR = 1.

register.name: PSELID
register.description: Peripheral Select and Flexcomm module ID

enumeratedValue.name: UNLOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Peripheral select can be changed by software.

enumeratedValue.name: LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Peripheral select is locked and cannot be changed until this Flexcomm module or the entire device is reset.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_PRESENT
enumeratedValue.description: This Flexcomm module does not include the USART function.

enumeratedValue.name: PRESENT
enumeratedValue.description: This Flexcomm module includes the USART function.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_PRESENT
enumeratedValue.description: This Flexcomm module does not include the SPI function.

enumeratedValue.name: PRESENT
enumeratedValue.description: This Flexcomm module includes the SPI function.

field.name: ID
field.description: Module identifier for the selected function

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The I2C Master function is disabled. When disabled, the Master configuration settings are not changed, but the Master function is internally reset.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The I2C Master function is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The I2C slave function is disabled. When disabled, the Slave configuration settings are not changed, but the Slave function is internally reset.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The I2C slave function is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The I2C Monitor function is disabled. When disabled, the Monitor function configuration settings are not changed, but the Monitor function is internally reset.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The I2C Monitor function is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The time-out function is disabled. When disabled, the time-out function is internally reset.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The time-out function is enabled. Both types of time-out flags will be generated and will cause interrupts if those flags are enabled. Typically, only one time-out flag will be used in a system.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The Monitor function will not perform clock stretching. Software or DMA may not always be able to read data provided by the Monitor function before it (the data) is overwritten. This mode can be used when non-invasive monitoring is critical.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The Monitor function will perform clock stretching, to ensure that the software or DMA can read all incoming data supplied by the Monitor function.

enumeratedValue.name: IN_PROGRESS
enumeratedValue.description: In progress. Communication is in progress and the Master function is busy and cannot currently accept a command.

enumeratedValue.name: PENDING
enumeratedValue.description: Pending. The Master function needs software service or is in the idle state. If the master is not in the idle state, then the master is waiting to receive or transmit data, or is waiting for the NACK bit.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Idle. The Master function is available to be used for a new transaction.

enumeratedValue.name: RECEIVE_READY
enumeratedValue.description: Receive ready. Received data is available (in Master Receiver mode). Address plus Read was previously sent and Acknowledged by a slave.

enumeratedValue.name: TRANSMIT_READY
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit ready. Data can be transmitted (in Master Transmitter mode). Address plus Write was previously sent and Acknowledged by a slave.

enumeratedValue.name: NACK_DATA
enumeratedValue.description: NACK Data. Slave NACKed transmitted data.

enumeratedValue.name: ARBITRATION_LOSS
enumeratedValue.description: Arbitration loss. The Master function has experienced an Arbitration Loss. At this point, the Master function has already stopped driving the bus and has gone into an idle state. Software can respond by doing nothing, or by sending a Start (to attempt to gain control of the bus when the bus next becomes idle).

enumeratedValue.name: ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: The Master function has experienced a Start/Stop Error. A Start or Stop was detected at a time when Start or Stop is not allowed by the I2C specification. The Master interface has stopped driving the bus and gone into an idle state; no action is required. A request for a Start could be made, or software could attempt to make sure that the bus has not stalled.

enumeratedValue.name: IN_PROGRESS

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_STRETCHING

enumeratedValue.name: DESELECTED

This must be done after writing transmit data, reading received data, or any other housekeeping related to the next bus operation. Automatic Operation has different requirements. SLVCONTINUE should not be set unless SLVPENDING = 1.

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOMATIC_ACK
enumeratedValue.description: A header with matching SLVADR0 and matching direction as set by AUTOMATCHREAD will be ACKed immediately, allowing the master to move on to the data bytes. If the address matches SLVADR0, but the direction does not match AUTOMATCHREAD, then the behavior will depend on the SLVADR0[AUTONACK] bit: if AUTONACK is set, then it will be Nacked; if AUTONACK is clear, then a SlvPending interrupt is generated.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEASSERTED
enumeratedValue.description: SSEL is not deasserted. This piece of data is not treated as the end of a transfer. SSEL will not be deasserted at the end of this data.

enumeratedValue.name: DEASSERTED
enumeratedValue.description: SSEL is deasserted. This piece of data is treated as the end of a transfer. SSEL will be deasserted at the end of this piece of data.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_EOF
enumeratedValue.description: Data not EOF. This piece of data transmitted is not treated as the end of a frame.

enumeratedValue.name: EOF
enumeratedValue.description: Data EOF. This piece of data is treated as the end of a frame, causing the Frame_delay time to be inserted before subsequent data is transmitted.

enumeratedValue.name: READ
enumeratedValue.description: Read received data. Received data must be read, to allow transmission to proceed. SPI transmit will halt when the receive data FIFO is full. In slave mode, an overrun error will occur if received data is not read before new data is received.

enumeratedValue.name: IGNORE
enumeratedValue.description: Ignore received data. Received data is ignored, allowing transmission without reading unneeded received data. No receiver flags are generated.

enumeratedValue.name: LEN_4BITS
enumeratedValue.description: Data transfer is 4 bits in length

enumeratedValue.name: LEN_5BITS
enumeratedValue.description: Data transfer is 5 bits in length

enumeratedValue.name: LEN_16BITS
enumeratedValue.description: Data transfer is 16 bits in length

enumeratedValue.name: SOT0
enumeratedValue.description: This is not the 1st data after the SSELs went from deasserted to asserted

enumeratedValue.name: SOT1
enumeratedValue.description: This is the 1st data after the SSELs went from deasserted to asserted (i.e., any previous transfer has ended). This information can be used to identify the 1st piece of data in cases where the transfer length is greater than 16 bits.

enumeratedValue.name: MASTER

field.name: OETA
field.description: Output Enable Turnaround Time Enable for RS-485 Operation.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH

enumeratedValue.name: COMP0
enumeratedValue.description: Compensation = 0. This is the recommended setting.

enumeratedValue.name: COMP0
enumeratedValue.description: Compensation = 0. This is the recommended setting.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO is enabled. The FIFO must be enabled in order for the CPU or DMA to read data from the DMIC via the FIFODATA register.

enumeratedValue.name: RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Reset the FIFO. This must be cleared before resuming operation.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO level interrupts are not enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DMA requests based on FIFO level are enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ONEENTRY
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the FIFO has received one entry (is no longer empty).

enumeratedValue.name: TWOENTRIES
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the FIFO has received two entries.

enumeratedValue.name: ENTRIES15
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the FIFO has received 15 entries.

enumeratedValue.name: ENTRIES16
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger when the FIFO has received 16 entries (has become full).

field.name: PHY_FALL
field.description: Capture DMIC on Falling edge (0 means on rising)

enumeratedValue.name: RISING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Capture PDM_DATA on the rising edge of PDM_CLK.

enumeratedValue.name: FALLING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Capture PDM_DATA on the falling edge of PDM_CLK.

field.name: PHY_HALF
field.description: Use Half rate sampling (ie Clock to dmic is sent at half the speed than the decimator is providing)

enumeratedValue.name: STANDARD
enumeratedValue.description: Standard half rate sampling. The clock to the DMIC is sent at the same rate as the decimator is providing.

enumeratedValue.name: HALF_RATE
enumeratedValue.description: Use half rate sampling. The clock to the DMIC is sent at half the rate that the decimator is providing.

enumeratedValue.name: DO_NOT_SATURATE
enumeratedValue.description: Do not Saturate. Results roll over if out range and do not saturate.

enumeratedValue.name: SATURATE
enumeratedValue.description: Saturate. If the result overflows, it saturates at 0xFFFF for positive overflow and 0x8000 for negative overflow.

enumeratedValue.name: USE_1FS
enumeratedValue.description: Use 1 FS output for PCM data.

enumeratedValue.name: USE_2FS
enumeratedValue.description: Use 2 FS output for PCM data.

field.name: HPFS
field.description: The HPFS field chooses the High Pass filter in first part of HWVAD.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal operation, waiting for HWVAD trigger event (stage 0).

enumeratedValue.name: RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Reset internal interrupt flag by writing a '1' (stage 1) pulse.

field.name: WAS
field.description: Write CRC DATA register As Seed

enumeratedValue.name: WAS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to the CRC DATA register are data values.

enumeratedValue.name: WAS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to the CRC DATA register are seed values.

field.name: FXOR
field.description: Complement Read Of CRC DATA register

enumeratedValue.name: FXOR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Invert or complement the read value of the CRC DATA register.

enumeratedValue.name: TOTR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Bits in bytes are transposed; bytes are not transposed.

enumeratedValue.name: TOTR_2
enumeratedValue.description: Both bits in bytes and bytes are transposed.

enumeratedValue.name: TOTR_3
enumeratedValue.description: Only bytes are transposed; no bits in a byte are transposed.

enumeratedValue.name: TOT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Bits in bytes are transposed; bytes are not transposed.

enumeratedValue.name: TOT_2
enumeratedValue.description: Both bits in bytes and bytes are transposed.

enumeratedValue.name: TOT_3
enumeratedValue.description: Only bytes are transposed; no bits in a byte are transposed.

enumeratedValue.name: OVERRUN_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: Debug Overrun Error. A debug overrun occurred.

enumeratedValue.name: AHB_OVERRUN_ERR
enumeratedValue.description: AHB Overrun Error. An AHB overrun occurred.

field.name: DTSEG1

field.name: RX

enumeratedValue.name: NO_WRITE_ACCESS
enumeratedValue.description: No write access. The CPU has no write access to the protected configuration registers.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITE_ACCESS
enumeratedValue.description: Write access. The CPU has write access to the protected configuration registers.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED

enumeratedValue.description: Timeout is controlled by Rx FIFO 1.

enumeratedValue.name: BELOW_ERR_LVL
enumeratedValue.description: Below error level. The receive counter is below the error passive level of 128.

enumeratedValue.name: AT_ERR_LVL
enumeratedValue.description: At error level. The receive counter has reached the error passive level of 128.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: No error: No error has occurred since the LEC bits has been reset by successful reception or transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: STUFF_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Stuff error: More than 5 equal bits in a sequence have occurred in a part of a received message where not allowed.

enumeratedValue.name: FORM_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Form error: A fixed format part of a received frame has the wrong format.

enumeratedValue.name: ACK_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: AckError: The message transmitted by the MCAN was not acknowledged by another node.

enumeratedValue.name: BIT1_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Bit1Error: During the transmission of a message (with the exception of the arbitration field), the device wanted to send a recessive level (bit of logical value 1), but the monitored bus value was dominant.

enumeratedValue.name: BIT0_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: Bit0Error: During the transmission of a message (or acknowledge bit, or active error flag, or overload flag), the device wanted to send a dominant level (data or identifier bit logical value 0), but the monitored bus value was recessive. During Bus_Off recovery this status is set each time a sequence of 11 recessive bits has been monitored. This enables the CPU to monitor the processing of the Bus_Off recovery sequence (indicating the bus is not stuck at dominant or continuously disturbed).

enumeratedValue.name: CRC_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: CRCError: The CRC check sum of a received message was incorrect. The CRC of an incoming message does not match with the CRC calculated from the received data.

enumeratedValue.name: NOCHANGE
enumeratedValue.description: NoChange: Any read access to the protocol status register re-initializes the LEC bits to 0x7. When the LEC equals the value 0x7, no CAN bus event was detected since the last CPU read access to the protocol status register.

enumeratedValue.name: SYNCHRONIZING
enumeratedValue.description: Synchronizing - node is synchronizing on CAN communication.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLE
enumeratedValue.description: Idle - node is neither receiver nor transmitter.

enumeratedValue.name: RX
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver - node is operating as receiver.

enumeratedValue.name: TX
enumeratedValue.description: Transmitter - node is operating as transmitter.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The MCAN is in the Error_Passive state.

enumeratedValue.name: TPRICTRL_0

enumeratedValue.description: If a higher priority trigger is received during command processing, the current command is stopped after after completing the current conversion. If averaging is enabled, the averaging loop will be completed. However, CMDHa[LOOP] will be ignored and the higher priority trigger will be serviced.

enumeratedValue.name: TPRICTRL_2
enumeratedValue.description: If a higher priority trigger is received during command processing, the current command will be completed (averaging, looping, compare) before servicing the higher priority trigger.

enumeratedValue.description: Trigger sequences interrupted by a high priority trigger exception are not automatically resumed or restarted.

enumeratedValue.name: TRES_1
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger sequences interrupted by a high priority trigger exception are automatically resumed or restarted.

enumeratedValue.name: TCMDRES_0
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger sequences interrupted by a high priority trigger exception is automatically restarted.

enumeratedValue.name: TCMDRES_1
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger sequences interrupted by a high priority trigger exception is resumed from the command executing before the exception.

enumeratedValue.name: HPT_EXDI_0
enumeratedValue.description: High priority trigger exceptions are enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: HPT_EXDI_1
enumeratedValue.description: High priority trigger exceptions are disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: PWREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are only enabled while conversions are active. Performance is affected due to analog startup delays.

enumeratedValue.name: PWREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are pre-enabled and ready to execute conversions without startup delays (at the cost of higher DC current consumption). A single power up delay (CFG[PUDLY]) is executed immediately once PWREN is set, and any detected trigger does not begin ADC operation until the power up delay time has passed. After this initial delay expires the analog will remain pre-enabled, and no additional delays will be executed.

enumeratedValue.description: Hardware triggering not used for channel.

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE_LOW_FALLING

enumeratedValue.name: ACTIVE_HIGH_RISING
enumeratedValue.description: Active high - rising edge. Hardware trigger is active high or rising edge triggered, based on TRIGTYPE.

enumeratedValue.name: EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Edge. Hardware trigger is edge triggered. Transfers will be initiated and completed, as specified for a single trigger.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED

field.name: VALIDPENDING

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_TRIGGERED

enumeratedValue.name: TRIGGERED

enumeratedValue.description: Disable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: HSEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support disabled. AHB clock and serial clock will not be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support enabled. AHB clock and serial clock will be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

field.name: COMBINATIONEN
field.description: This bit is to support Flash Octal mode access by combining Port A and B Data pins (A_DATA[3:0] and B_DATA[3:0]), when Port A and Port B are of 4 bit data width.

field.name: SCKFREERUNEN
field.description: This bit is used to force SCLK output free-running. For FPGA applications, external device may use SCLK as reference clock to its internal PLL. If SCLK free-running is enabled, data sampling with loopback clock from SCLK pad is not supported (MCR0[RXCLKSRC]=2).

field.name: LEARNEN
field.description: This bit is used to enable/disable data learning feature. When data learning is disabled, the sampling clock phase 0 is always used for RX data sampling even if LEARN instruction is correctly executed.

field.name: IPGRANTWAIT
field.description: Time out wait cycle for IP command grant.

field.name: AHBGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeout wait cycle for AHB command grant.

field.name: AHBBUSWAIT
field.description: AHB Read/Write access to Serial Flash Memory space will timeout if not data received from Flash or data not transmitted after AHBBUSWAIT * 1024 ahb clock cycles, AHB Bus will get an error response

field.name: SEQWAIT
field.description: Command Sequence Execution will timeout and abort after SEQWAIT * 1024 Serial Root Clock cycles

field.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT
field.description: This bit determines whether AHB RX Buffer and AHB TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI returns STOP mode ACK. Software should set this bit if AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer will be powered off in STOP mode. Otherwise AHB read access after exiting STOP mode may hit AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer but their data entries are invalid.

enumeratedValue.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will not be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

enumeratedValue.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

field.name: CLRLEARNPHASE
field.description: The sampling clock phase selection will be reset to phase 0 when this bit is written with 0x1. This bit will be auto-cleared immediately.

field.name: SAMEDEVICEEN
field.description: All external devices are same devices (both in types and size) for A1/A2/B1/B2.

enumeratedValue.name: individual_parallel
enumeratedValue.description: In Individual mode, FLSHA1CRx/FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2 separately. In Parallel mode, FLSHA1CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1 and B1, FLSHA2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A2 and B2. FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register settings will be ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: FLSHA1CR0/FLSHA1CR1/FLSHA1CR2 register settings will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2. FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx will be ignored.

field.name: SCKBDIFFOPT
field.description: B_SCLK pad can be used as A_SCLK differential clock output (inverted clock to A_SCLK). In this case, port B flash access is not available. After changing the value of this field, MCR0[SWRESET] should be set.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKBDIFFOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port B SCLK clock output. Port B flash access is available.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKBDIFFOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port A SCLK inverted clock output (Differential clock to A_SCLK). Port B flash access is not available.

field.name: RXCLKSRC_B
field.description: Sample Clock source selection for Flash Reading

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_B_0
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback internally.

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_B_1
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback from DQS pad.

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_B_2
enumeratedValue.description: SCLK output clock and loopback from SCLK pad

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_B_3
enumeratedValue.description: Flash provided Read strobe and input from DQS pad

field.name: RX_CLK_SRC_DIFF
field.description: Sample Clock source or source_b selection for Flash Reading

field.name: RESUMEWAIT
field.description: Wait cycle (in AHB clock cycle) for idle state before suspended command sequence resumed.

field.name: APAREN
field.description: Parallel mode enabled for AHB triggered Command (both read and write) .

enumeratedValue.name: individual
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Parallel mode.

field.name: CLRAHBRXBUF
field.description: Clear the status/pointers of AHB RX Buffer. Auto-cleared.

field.name: CACHABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus cachable read access support.

enumeratedValue.name: CACHABLEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will not check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer.

enumeratedValue.name: CACHABLEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer first.

field.name: BUFFERABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus bufferable write access support.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFFERABLEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. For all AHB write access (no matter bufferable or non-bufferable ), FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready after all data is transmitted to External device and AHB command finished.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFFERABLEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. For AHB bufferable write access, FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready when the AHB command is granted by arbitrator and will not wait for AHB command finished.

field.name: READADDROPT
field.description: AHB Read Address option bit. This option bit is intend to remove AHB burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: READADDROPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: There is AHB read burst start address alignment limitation when flash is accessed in parallel mode or flash is word-addressable.

enumeratedValue.name: READADDROPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: There is no AHB read burst start address alignment limitation. FlexSPI will fetch more data than AHB burst required to meet the alignment requirement.

enumeratedValue.name: READSZALIGN_0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB read size will be decided by other register setting like PREFETCH_EN

enumeratedValue.name: READSZALIGN_1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB read size to up size to 8 bytes aligned, no prefetching

field.name: ALIGNMENT
field.description: Decides all AHB read/write boundary. All access cross the boundary will be divided into smaller sub accesses.

field.description: Clear the instruction pointer which is internally saved pointer by JMP_ON_CS.

field.name: WMOPT1
field.description: Write mask option bit 1. This option bit could be used to remove AHB write burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is no limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will not be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

field.name: WMENA
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port A. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port A, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be un-driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

field.name: WMENB
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port B. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port B, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENB_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be un-driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENB_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDMAEN_1

enumeratedValue.name: TXDMAEN_1

field.name: DLLRESET
field.description: Software could force a reset on DLL by setting this field to 0x1. This will cause the DLL to lose lock and re-calibrate to detect an ref_clock half period phase shift. The reset action is edge triggered, so software need to clear this bit after set this bit (no delay limitation).

field.name: SLVDLYTARGET
field.description: The delay target for slave delay line is: ((SLVDLYTARGET+1) * 1/32 * clock cycle of reference clock (serial root clock). If serial root clock is >= 100 MHz, DLLEN set to 0x1, OVRDEN set to =0x0, then SLVDLYTARGET setting of 0xF is recommended.

field.name: OVRDEN
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override enable.

field.name: OVRDVAL
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override value.

field.name: SEQIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in SEQ_CTL is idle and there is command sequence executing on FlexSPI interface.

field.name: ARBIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in ARB_CTL is busy and there is command sequence granted by arbitrator and not finished yet on FlexSPI interface. When ARB_CTL state (ARBIDLE=0x1) is idle, there will be no transaction on FlexSPI interface also (SEQIDLE=0x1). So this bit should be polled to wait for FlexSPI controller become idle instead of SEQIDLE.

field.name: ARBCMDSRC
field.description: This status field indicates the trigger source of current command sequence granted by arbitrator. This field value is meaningless when ARB_CTL is not busy (STS0[ARBIDLE]=0x1).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB read command (triggered by AHB read).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB write command (triggered by AHB Write).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_2
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by IP command (triggered by setting register bit IPCMD.TRG).

field.name: DATALEARNPHASEA

field.name: DATALEARNPHASEB

field.name: AHBCMDERRCODE

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_2

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_3

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_5
